Bichon Frise Mix Who Was Surrendered When Diagnosed With Diabetes Now Searching For Love
Great Dog Rescue New England, a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, recently introduced Lucy Marshmallow, a charming five-year-old Bichon Frise and Miniature Poodle mix who recently came into rescue care through no fault of her own. Lucy originally had a family of her own whom she had been living with since she was young. Unfortunately, that family surrendered her when they found out she was diabetic. “They would not be able to keep up with her insulin with their schedules and would rather give her a life with a loving family who can give her the love and support she deserves,” said GDRNE. Luckily, the rescue was there to take her into their care, and she has since been placed with a loving foster family that can keep up with her needs until she finds her true forever family.
